Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Commonwealth of Gythena
====================================================
With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Gythena agree to adhere to the following points:
_T_______________R_______________A_______________D_______________E_______________!_
Resource Section.
1.a: Nordiheim agrees to open its markets of Iron and Aluminium to Gythena for it to buy these resources as needed.

1.b: Gythena agrees to open its markets of Gas and Phosphoros to Nordiheim for it to buy these resources as needed.

1.c: The quanteties of these resources will be ordered and delivered on a quarterly bassis.

1.d: The values of these resources will be based on world market prices on a quarterly bassis.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Trade Section.
2.a: Both nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods, luxury goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity.

2.b: This will allow Nordiheim to buy from Gythenas quality lumber, alcohols and meats.

2.c: This will allow Gythena to buy from Nordiheims large range of exotic fruits & berries, steel products and precious stones.

2.d: Neither nation are allowed to place tarifs or special taxes on goods or services from the other nation without both nations coming together to discuss and reach a mutual agreement of understanding and consent.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
3: In the interest of friendship and co-operation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Gythena be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of the deal between the two nations as long as both parties can arrive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Signatory parties
The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim ___________________ The Low Council of The Commonwealth of Gythena
